description: Exploit, as a near-free accuracy lever (W1 and W3 crux). On the E010 recipe, change only the label smoothing from 0.3 to 0.2 (the airbench96_faster value) in the training loss. Epochs, resizing, Muon/SGD settings and Lookahead/EMA stay the same, and so do the compiled shapes. Since the loss changes only by a constant, no extra warm-up is needed beyond the usual error_on_recompile check.
